name: Minky's Simple Sandbox 3.0: Syria
summary: Syria sandbox mission for air-to-air and air-to-ground practice in fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft.
description: Single `.miz` training sandbox on the Syria map. The A-4E-C and UH-60L mods are optional. The page gives no install path; missions normally go in `Saved Games\DCS\Missions`.

releases.changelog: Changelog lists a 6/11/2025 update adding OH-58, CH-47 and F-4E spawns.
